dataset: Wikimedia Commons + Open Images v5 licensed food images, expansion v2

selection.selectionMetric: validation macro-F1 over labels with validation support, then validation top-1
selection.tta: center crop + horizontal flip logits average

limitations: Commons weak category labels and Open Images bounding-box annotations; no complete local manual review
v1 test retired; scores are not directly comparable to the old 22-class benchmark
Legacy categories without fresh holdout remain train-only; no v2 accuracy claim for them; macro-F1 averages only labels with test support
Near-duplicate groups isolated; photographer/session leakage may remain
ImageNet pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out
Open Images source crops are easier than unlocalized full meal photographs; cross-source domain shift is not measured
Closed-set single-dish categories; no independent real-user-photo or unknown-food benchmark
Softmax scores are uncalibrated; no ground-truth portion weight or nutrition
No comparison against production vision provider on this holdout
